results.summary: The Red Ledge pin sat about 3.5 km too far south, down near Yang Yang Lakes; it now sits on the ledge just south of Kool-Aid Lake below Arts Knoll. All other pins were already right.
results.evidence: Pin 4 Red Ledge was at 48.400043,-121.043071 (ground 5,680 ft), ~3.5 km south of Kool-Aid Lake and beside Yang Yang Lakes (OSM 48.39380,-121.05662) — not where the ledge is. The ledge runs west beneath Arts Knoll just south of Kool-Aid Lake: OSM places Arts Knoll at 48.43059,-121.04257; a published traverse map marks 'Red ledge' at 48.43093,-121.05071 and its drawn track runs west along ~48.4314 between -121.0469 and -121.0498 south of the lake; trip accounts describe the ledge as cutting west through the cliff below Arts Knoll right after Kool-Aid Lake. New point 48.4314,-121.0480 is ~200 m from the map marker, on the drawn track, and ~420 m west of the knoll summit along the band it describes. Ground height 6,510 ft (USGS). Other pins checked: Cascade Pass Trailhead, Cascade Pass (map 48.46790,-121.05888), Cache Col (map 48.44871,-121.05219), Kool-Aid Lake (OSM 48.4386686,-121.0458149, identical), LeConte Glacier (OSM centroid 48.36244,-121.03525, ~150 m), Old Guard Peak summit (OSM 48.35603,-121.03583, ~65 m) — all within tolerance. The snowfinger pin sits between glacier and summit on the north side as the text describes; no source places it more precisely, so it is left.
